question: Automobile A travels a distance in 2 hours at a speed of 42 km/hr. Automobile B travels twice the distance traveled by A in 5 hours. Find the speed (in km/hr) of Automobile B.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Automobile A = 42 km/hr

Time taken by Automobile A = 2 hours

Distance traveled by Automobile B = 2 × Distance traveled by Automobile A

Time taken by Automobile B = 5 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance traveled by Automobile A = 42 × 2

⇒ Distance traveled by Automobile A = 84 km

⇒ Distance traveled by Automobile B = 2 × 84

⇒ Distance traveled by Automobile B = 168 km

⇒ Speed of Automobile B = Distance ÷ Time

⇒ Speed of Automobile B = 168 ÷ 5

⇒ Speed of Automobile B = 33.6 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 33.6 km/hr.**
